svg.title: Ninnup Ship’s Boat - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 38-39, PDF 39-40. Complete single-deck envelope preserves long clipped nose, widening straight wings, chamfered aft shoulders and small central stern recess. Illustration corroborates broad diamond-like rear body and slender nose. Internal command/automation compartments are not used as hull boundaries.
